name: Rivanicline
aliases: metanicotine, (E)-metanicotine, RJR-2403, TC 2403, TC-2403, TC2403, trans-metanicotine
summary: Rivanicline (TC-2403, RJR-2403, (E)-metanicotine) is a drug which acts as a partial agonist at neural nicotinic acetylcholine receptors. It is subtype-selective, binding primarily to the α4β2 subtype.

pharmacology.text: Rivanicline (TC-2403, RJR-2403, (E)-metanicotine) is a drug which acts as a partial agonist at neural nicotinic acetylcholine receptors. It is subtype-selective, binding primarily to the α4β2 subtype.

uses.en: It was studied for ulcerative colitis and for conditions involving thinking and memory. It is not an approved medicine.
uses.zh: 它曾被研究用於潰瘍性結腸炎，以及與思考和記憶有關的疾病，並不是核准的藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被研究用于溃疡性结肠炎，以及与思考和记忆有关的疾病，并不是核准的药物。

sideEffects.en: Reported effects in trials include nausea, headache and dizziness, which are common with drugs acting on nicotinic receptors.
sideEffects.zh: 試驗中已知的副作用包括噁心、頭痛和頭暈，這些在作用於菸鹼受體的藥物中很常見。
sideEffects.zhHans: 试验中已知的副作用包括恶心、头痛和头晕，这些在作用于烟碱受体的药物中很常见。

fact.en: Rivanicline is an opened-up nicotine: the pyrrolidine ring is replaced by a straight chain with a double bond, which is why it is also called metanicotine.
fact.zh: Rivanicline 相當於把尼古丁打開：吡咯啶環被換成一條帶雙鍵的直鏈，因此它也被稱為 metanicotine。
fact.zhHans: Rivanicline 相当于把尼古丁打开：吡咯啶环被换成一条带双键的直链，因此它也被称为 metanicotine。
